_comment: Copy to config.json (or config.local.json for machine-local tweaks, which is gitignored and merged on top). Every key is optional; defaults live in src/config.js.

discovery._comment: depth 1 = direct children of workspace_root. Raise it if you nest by owner (~/code/<owner>/<repo>). Directory names in exclusions are skipped at any depth; names starting with '.' are always skipped.

clone._comment: hosts: which git hosts list_available_repos / draft-PR creation talk to. Credentials come from `git credential fill` (your git credential helper) — never from this file. type: github | gitea | gitlab. api_base overrides the default API URL.

claude._comment: bin: claude executable (PATH or absolute). extra_args: appended verbatim to every invocation, AFTER the flags the bridge builds — so do NOT put --effort or --model here, they would silently override models.tiers.*.effort and the tier model. Model and effort choice live under models.

models._comment: Tier names are policy; model ids must be ones the installed Claude Code accepts (confirmed for 2.1.251: claude-opus-5, claude-fable-5, claude-haiku-4-5). An unavailable model fails the job loudly - no fallback. Each tier may name an effort level (low|medium|high|xhigh|max); Claude Code's own default is high, and on routine work thinking tokens dominate wall-clock time, so high everywhere is the slow default. Escalation triggers are crude on purpose and expected to be tuned; complexity "low" de-escalates to fast_tier.

compose._comment: protected: project directory names OR compose project names the bridge refuses to restart/stop/up/redeploy (status/logs still work). Keep the stack serving the chat UI and any other MCP servers here. Remove an entry to opt out.

projects._comment: Per-project overrides keyed by directory name. default_branch: use when it can't be inferred. allow_untracked: don't count untracked files as a dirty tree. tier: default model tier for this project (escalation can still raise it).

goals._comment: Goals group jobs across projects under one objective, one budget and one shared findings record. budget_usd covers ALL children together and is checked before each dispatch.

notify._comment: Live job/goal state posted to an Open WebUI channel. Create a channel, add a webhook, and put the full URL in config.local.json (gitignored) — it carries a token. Format: http://HOST/api/v1/channels/webhooks/<webhook_id>/<token> chat_base_url is the chat UI origin (e.g. https://chat.example.com) so feed lines can link back to the conversation. api_key + channel_id additionally enable ASKING the user a question in the channel and waiting for a reply (an Open WebUI API key that can read the channel). Both belong in config.local.json.

failover._comment: When a job dies because the ACCOUNT ran out of room (subscription session cap, rate limit), requeue it ONCE with an Anthropic API key in its environment so the work finishes instead of waiting for the cap to reset. Off by default: the subscription is flat-rate while a key is billed per token, so this trades a stall for a bill. Put api_key in config.local.json (gitignored), never here.
